question: The volume of a cylinder is 1650 m³, whereas the surface area of its base is 78(4)/(7) m². Find the height of the cylinder.
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of a cylinder = 1650 m3

Surface area of the base of the cylinder = 78(4)/(7) m²

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × R² × H cubic unit

Base area of a cylinder = π × R2 sq. unit

**Calculation:**

Let, radius of the base of a cylinder = R m,

height of the cylinder = H m

According to the question,

π × R2 × H = 1650

⇒ 78(4)/(7) ×​​​ H = 1650​

⇒ 550/7 × H = 1650

⇒ H = 1650 × 7/550 = 21

**∴ The height of the cylinder is 21 m.**
